answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 19269 Country: Pakistan Title: Is pre-ejaculation (mazi) is napak? If it is touched with cloths then we may offer prayer in these cloths? Question: Is pre-ejaculation (mazi) is napak? If it is touched with cloths then we may offer prayer in these cloths? Please? Answer ID: 19269 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 150/150M=1431) Yes, the mazi (pre-ejaculation fluid) is impure, if cloth is smeared with it, salah can be offered in it after washing the impurity. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
